data.one_liner: Fast on‑device NoSQL object database for Flutter and Dart native apps.
data.what_it_does: ObjectBox stores Dart objects directly without tables, offering ACID‑compliant CRUD, queries, relations and vector search. It also provides optional Sync for cross‑device data consistency.
use_when: You need high‑performance local persistence with millions of objects
You want built‑in relations and query API without writing SQL
You plan to use on‑device vector search for AI features
avoid_when: You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without native binaries
You need a lightweight key‑value store only
You cannot add native build steps or code‑generation to your CI
strengths: Cross‑platform native binaries (Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows)
weaknesses: Requires native libraries and code‑gen step
Larger app size due to native binaries
Not pure Dart – limited to supported platforms
data.setup_notes: Add objectbox and objectbox_flutter_libs (or sync variant) to pubspec, run build_runner for generated code, install native libs via provided script, and set platform deployment targets (iOS 15+, macOS 11+).

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure SQLite wrapper, pure Dart, no native code‑gen needed

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight pure‑Dart key‑value store, easier setup

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: SQL‑based with code‑gen, supports complex queries and migrations
